test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 6th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 10 hours and 13(1)/(3) hours, respectively. Pipe C is an emptying pipe. When all the three pipes are opened together, the tank is filled in 8 hours. In how many hours will Pipe C alone empty 25% of the tank?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Part filled by Pipe A in 1 hour = 1over10

Part filled by Pipe B in 1 hour = 1over{13{1over3}} = 3over40 

⇒ Total part filled by A and B working together in 1 hour = 1over10 + 3over40 = 7over40

Let the Pipe empty 1over c part in 1 hour.

When all opened together-

⇒ 7over40 - 1over c = 1over 8

⇒ 1over c = 7over40 - 1over 8

⇒ 1over c = 7-5over40

⇒ 1over c = 2over 40

⇒ c = 20 hours

Time required by the Pipe C alone to empty 25% of the tank

⇒ 0.25 × 20 = 5 hours.

**∴ Pipe C would require 5 hours to empty the tank alone.**
